name: Charles Bussell
why: His freshman class portrait, the only photograph of him the volume carries; cut from the grid cell the page's own name key places him in.

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 371, freshman class portraits (Batson-Cook); the marginal name key runs nine names per block against nine photographs per row, and his line is the ninth of the seventh block, so his cell is row 7, column 9. The volume's index gives him pp. 282 and 371, and p. 282 is the Associated Student Government page, which ties this face to the senator rather than to a namesake.

name: Jim Brumfield
why: His class portrait in the volume covering his first year in the Congress; the only photograph of him the 1981 book carries.

src.label: 1981 Talisman, p. 349, class portraits (Brown-Bryant); the marginal name key runs nine names per block against nine photographs per row, and his line is the sixth of the third block, so his cell is row 3, column 6. The row's sequence of men and women matches the nine names in order, which is how the key was checked. He is the only James or Jim Brumfield in the volume's index, which lists otherwise only a Stanley and a Tammy Lynn Brumfield.
